source: The owner's account setup list (MR-054); copy is plain and names no provider; the coach adds a provider note per client

items.name: Tracking app linked
items.copy: We are linking, not looking. You log into each bank yourself; I will look away and we stop sharing the screen while you do.
items.gentle: Nothing linked gets reviewed on this call.
steps: Link checking, savings and every card
Stop sharing your screen while you log in

items.name: High-yield savings with buckets
items.copy: One savings account with a bucket for the cushion and one for each goal, named in your words.
steps: Name each one after a goal

items.name: Roth IRA opened
items.copy: Opening it today; how much goes in is a session 7 decision.

items.name: 401k portal
items.copy: Log in, check the beneficiary, confirm the match.

items.name: Credit card, only if it fits
items.copy: A balance transfer when there is a balance at a high rate; a rewards card only when nothing is carried. Your choice.

variants.balanceTransfer: A balance at {apr} could move to a card with a promo rate.
variants.rewards: Nothing carried: a rewards card earns on what you already spend.
variants.none: A card does not fit today.

items.name: Credit freeze
items.copy: Freeze at all three bureaus after any card application. Free, ten minutes.

items.name: Second checking for bills
items.copy: One account for bills, one for everything else.

items.name: HSA
items.copy: The paystub shows an HSA-eligible plan.

items.name: Employee assistance check
items.copy: Free sessions through work, if offered.

items.name: Password manager
items.copy: One place for every login, optional.

items.name: IRS identity PIN
items.copy: Stops someone filing in your name, optional.

items.name: Unclaimed property search
items.copy: Moved states or a forgotten account: a two-minute search.

items.name: IRS online account
items.copy: Balance, refund status and transcripts in one place.

items.name: my Social Security account
items.copy: Your record and your estimate, from session 7 on.

triggers.hsaEligible: HSA contributions on the paystub or an HSA-eligible plan
triggers.employerBenefits: employed by a company or nonprofit
triggers.movedOrForgotten: moved states or mentioned a forgotten account
triggers.taxOrSelfEmployed: owes taxes, a refund issue, self-employed or side income

orderInfo: The order of operations many coaches teach: the match first, then high-interest debt, then the cushion, then the Roth, then the rest of the 401k. Information, not advice; your choice.
